snippet.title: AI Research for Beginners: Find Sources and Verify Claims | Ep 11
snippet.description:
AI Research for Beginners: Find Sources and Verify Claims. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 11 of 50

What you will learn: Build research questions, request sources and verify independently.
Example: researching solar panels for a school project.
Try it: create a research checklist and verify one claim.
Remember: a model may invent citations or rely on outdated information.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.

snippet.title: AI Hallucinations: How to Spot and Check Confident Errors | Ep 12
snippet.description:
AI Hallucinations: How to Spot and Check Confident Errors. Learn with a simple example and a beginner exercise.

AI for Beginners — Episode 12 of 50

What you will learn: Recognize confident errors and corroborate important details.
Example: a made-up book title presented as real.
Try it: ask for sources and check an official page.
Remember: never trust unsupported claims in health, finance or legal matters.

Follow the series in episode order and practice with sample data. Share your question or exercise result in the comments.
